## Prep

Since last time (2026-07-09):

- No-show fees now has a date: end of October. Brasserie Lund was told at the [[meetings/{{date:2026-07-16}}-brasserie-lund-quarterly-review]] on 2026-07-16. [[people/asa-lindgren|Åsa]] was last told Q4, on 2026-07-09. Say it first, before Marcus does.
- The [[tickets/jira/BOK-300]] stories are drafted, three with three checks each, for sprint planning on 2026-07-22. [[people/rebecca-holm|Rebecca]] estimates them there, so there is no date before that.

Tickets since 2026-07-09:

- [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], the double reminder on Google bookings, was fixed on 2026-07-17.
- [[tickets/jira/GST-140]], table areas on the booking page, shipped on 2026-07-14.
- [[tickets/jira/PAY-210]], deposits, is still In Progress with no date.

Who owes an answer:

- [[people/henrik-dahl|Henrik]] owes a date for PAY-210, asked at the [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]]. Ask again in the room. Group bookings cannot start until he gives one.

What will come up:

- [[people/marcus-ek|Marcus]] will ask again to move group bookings up for [[customers/nordic-steak]], as he did at the [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]]. The answer is the decision of 2026-06-18, [[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]]: it waits on deposits, so Q1 2027.
- [[tickets/jira/GST-77]], Google bookings, has been live since 2026-05-12, and nobody has told sales in writing. Marcus still lists it as coming. One message to him settles it.
input.rationale: Four people in the room. The memory shows what each has not heard since 2026-07-09: Åsa the October date, Marcus that the Google button is live. PAY-210 still has no date for anyone.

turns.text: One thing to do before you walk in: tell [[people/asa-lindgren|Åsa]] the October date yourself, before Marcus does.
